I ported the LRU simulator to Rust, and it passes all 5 cases in `node check.mjs`.

- **Code:** `src/lru.rs` holds the cache: a `HashMap` that points into a doubly linked list stored in a `Vec`, which reuses freed slots, so every command is O(1). `src/main.rs` reads the input and runs the commands. It only uses the standard library.
- **Build:** `build.sh` runs `cargo build --release` and copies the binary to `./app`.
- **Same results as the C++ version:** I generated two 1,000,000-command
